about: Turnout's price and any sale, as the pages show them. Every page with a price reads this file when it opens; scripts/publish-site.sh also writes it into the pages for browsers without scripts. price: the list price. sale: null, or the sale price, the last day it applies (YYYY-MM-DD; the line disappears the day after) and one sentence per language naming {sale}, {ends} (written as a date in that language) and {price}. Polar's checkout applies the discount itself: its end date there must be the same day.

text.zh-Hant: 上市優惠價 {sale}，到 {ends}為止，之後為 {price}。
text.ja: 発売記念価格{sale}（{ends}まで）。その後は{price}です。
text.es: Precio de lanzamiento: {sale} hasta el {ends}; después, {price}.
